messages:
Priya (Reliability): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands incident segment. RCA link: https://internal.redwood.com/rca/INC-2205432. Sharing immediate asks and owners here so we can close the loop.

Marcus (CTO): Thx. Two asks from leadership: 1) a short customer-facing blurb we can post to status.redwood.ai, 2) an internal one-pager for execs summarizing business impact.

Anika (SRE): I'll take the status page blurb. Will base it on the timeline in the RCA and include mitigation steps we used. ETA: 2205433000.

Ravi (Product): Can we get clarity on whether the cache fallback needs a hotfix or we re-prioritize the refactor? I'd like to avoid a breaking customer-facing change mid-quarter.

Priya (Reliability): Short answer: patching the cache config reduced incidents; recurrence risk still possible under certain load patterns. Recommend a short-term patch (low risk) and a scoped refactor planning ticket.

Marta (Legal): Please run customer wording by us before public posting; use the template here: /templates/customer-comms/incident-template.md

ops-bot: Incident INC-2205432: RCA uploaded; tasks created.

Priya (Reliability): Action items (owner -> due):
- Anika -> status page + public blurb (due 2205433000)
- Ravi -> create roadmap ticket and scope (due 2205433600)
- Marcus -> exec one-pager sign-off (due 2205433300)
- Priya -> add regression test for cache scenario + link to CI (due 2205434200)
- Marta -> quick legal review of public wording (due 2205433100)

Anika (SRE): Ack. Posting draft in #support-desk in 20m and will ping Legal.

Ravi (Product): Ack. I'll split ticket into: hotfix assessment + spec for refactor; assign engineers after triage.

Marcus (CTO): Ack. I'll review the one-pager after Anika's status blurb lands so numbers match.

Priya (Reliability): Metric names to monitor (canonical): `service_cache_ops_total`, `cache_fallbacks_total`, `request_latency_p95`. I'll paste Grafana links in DMs.

Marta (Legal): Will review the draft once posted. Note: avoid language implying guaranteed credits until Product/Finance confirm.

Anika (SRE): Draft posted: https://internal.redwood.com/drafts/status-inc-2205432. Pinged Legal.

Priya (Reliability): One more note: ops rotation next week two people OOO on Tues; please flag if you need shift swaps.

ops-bot: Task created "Legal review of status blurb for INC-2205432" assigned to Marta, due 2205433100.

Ravi (Product): Triage meeting set: Thu 9:30am PT. Agenda: impact analysis, hotfix vs refactor decision, customer comms timeline.

Marcus (CTO): If hotfix required we should aim for a canary rollout only. Agree on triage agenda.

Marta (Legal): Reviewed the draft, left two inline edits on tone and a compliance note.

Anika (SRE): Status page updated and public blurb posted after legal ok. Marking my task done.

Priya (Reliability): Confirming: Anika done, Marta done, Marcus to sign exec one-pager, Ravi to create roadmap ticket, I'll follow up on the regression test.

Marcus (CTO): One-pager signed. I'll drop it to execs and cc Finance.

Ravi (Product): Roadmap ticket created: https://internal.redwood.com/tickets/RD-2205432. Assigning to infra squad for scope.

Priya (Reliability): Thanks all. I'll update the RCA with owners and close action tracker once regression test is green. If anyone needs access to the RCA or artifacts DM me. :thumbsup:
